    StartersFamily Truckster sweet and salty trail mixPeanuts, pretzels and cornflakes in honey butter, with chocolate and cranberriesHow to make it60g butter60g brown sugar2 tbsp honey200g roasted peanuts150g pretzel twists60g cornflakes1 pinch salt150g chocolate buttons100g dried cranberriesMelt the butter with the sugar and honey.Toss with the peanuts, pretzels, cornflakes and salt on a lined tray.Bake at 160°C, stirring halfway.Cool completely, then toss through the chocolate buttons and cranberries.Pack into paper bags or a lidded box.Marty Moose corn dogsCornmeal-battered franks fried golden, with mustard. Sorry, folks.How to make it150g fine cornmeal100g plain flour2 tbsp caster sugar2 tsp baking powder1 egg250ml buttermilk8 hot dog franks1 L vegetable oil4 tbsp yellow mustardWhisk the cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, egg and buttermilk into a batter.Pat the franks dry and push onto sticks.Heat the oil to 180°C.Dip the franks in batter and fry until deep golden.Serve with mustard.Kansas cheese and chive corn frittersThe drive through Kansas corn countryHow to make itAs written, serves 4Sweet corn fritters with cheddar and chives, fried crisp and golden, with a smoky chipotle sour cream for dipping.Mix 2 cups corn kernels (from 3 cobs) with 150g self-raising flour, 2 eggs, 125ml milk, 100g grated cheddar, chopped chives and salt.Heat 1cm oil in a frying pan over medium heat.Drop in heaped tablespoons and fry 2 minutes a side until golden.Drain on paper.Mix 200g sour cream with 1 chopped chipotle in adobo and a squeeze of lime for dipping.Funnel cake with icing sugarRoy Walley's treat. BB gun not included.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsEddie's Kansas brisket bitesSmoked paprika brisket cubes roasted low and tossed in barbecue sauceHow to make it1.5kg beef brisket point2 tbsp smoked paprika1 tsp salt200ml barbecue sauce2 tbsp brown sugarCut the brisket into 4cm cubes.Rub with smoked paprika and salt.Roast at 140°C.Toss with barbecue sauce and brown sugar.Return to the oven until sticky.SweetsWalley World toffee applesApples dipped in red hard toffee, served with a bag of fairy flossHow to make it4 apples400g caster sugar125ml water1 tsp white vinegar3 drops of red food colouring1 bag fairy flossPush sticks into the apples.Boil the sugar, water and vinegar without stirring to 150°C.Add the red colouring.Dip and twirl each apple, then set on baking paper.Serve with fairy floss.DrinksFamily Truckster strawberry lemonadeStrawberry and lemon topped with soda water, with sliced fruit and iceHow to make it300g strawberries5 lemons, juiced150ml sugar syrup1 L cold water500ml soda water1 cup iceJuice the lemons and blend most of the strawberries with the juice and syrup until smooth.Strain into a jug.Add the cold water and soda water and stir.Pour over ice with sliced strawberries and lemon.Motel pool Arnold PalmerFor the motel pool, Clark. Keep your shorts on.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
